description: WP-S4 Space Wolves OLD GREYMANES (Grey Hunters) and LET LOOSE THE WOLVES (Wolf Guard Headtakers) in the real Declare Battle Formations dialog. Fixture sw11e_s4_formations (Formations phase, both armies undeployed). The dialog's UNIT SPLITS (SPACE WOLVES) section has a Split button per unit; pressing it routes SW11E_SPLIT_UNIT through FormationsPhase and rebuilds the form: Grey Hunters 10 -> 5 + 5; Headtakers -> 3 Headtakers + 3 Hunting Wolves (Hunting Wolf profile M10). The new units are offered as bodyguards in the rebuilt leader section; Murderfang (Force of Untamed Destruction) is never a Warlord choice.

steps.comment: the UNIT SPLITS section lists the Grey Hunters (Old Greymanes)
... and the Headtakers (Let Loose the Wolves)
real click: Split on the first row (Grey Hunters)
Old Greymanes: the Grey Hunters keep 5 models
... the new unit has the other 5
the rebuilt form no longer offers the split Grey Hunters
real click: Split on the remaining row (Headtakers)
Let Loose the Wolves: the Hunting Wolves unit has the Hunting Wolf profile (M10)
the Headtakers keep their 3 Headtaker models
nothing left to split: the section is gone after the rebuild
